module
public import Init

set_option warn.«sorry» false
example : String := s! "{(by exact 1 : Nat)}"
example : String := s! /- nested /- comment -/ -/ "{(by exact 2 : Nat)}"
example : String := s!
  "{(by exact 3 : Nat)}"
example : Nat := dbg_trace "{(by exact 4 : Nat)}"; 0
